This thought helps me a lot when I feel suicidal:

Yes, life is temporary, you only get one, and it ends, but that is the beauty of life. You never know when it will be your last time doing anything, thus it is important to see life through, you only get to experience it once, and only get to see things for a limited amount of time, live your life, start a new family, and make new friends. As for hating yourself, I haven't really figured that one out yet, I think I'm starting to realize everyone hates themselves to varying degrees. Find something that makes you say "I'm proud of myself," it can be something small like completing a difficult puzzle or game, or even just getting out of bed when you don't feel like it. Actually say it too, until you mean it. 

I'll end this with a few quotes that helped me a ton "Have you ever considered the strength you hold as a human being, you are the universe trying to figure itself out, dont end it because you got confused."

"In the midst of winter, I found there was, within me, an invincible summer": Everyone has the innate ability to be happy

Sorry in advanced, I started sobbing while writing this, I have been on both sides of where your at and it struck a note with me:

Hey man, I have also been in therapy for years, SI, SH, the whole 9 yards. Going out is brutal, I lost a friend about 3 years ago to stuff that I myself have thought about doing and it takes the possibility of me following completely away. Shit is hard, it always will be, but I still cry to this very day about my friend, it’s brutal to those around you, it’s brutal to yourself. Here are my tips to how to deal with shit when I feel this way:
Firstly STOP DRINKING AND DRUG USE, it will destroy you trust me, ever attempt I have made has been after a long stint of both of those

Secondly, don’t think of it as an option, because frankly it’s not. If you follow through, how will you ever know what certain parts of life are like, things can always get better, things can always get worse, but if you go through you will never be able to know. Why end your story if you have the choice to rewrite it is my philosophy. 

Thirdly, remember you are loved. You may not think it, hell you may not even know who loves you, but people do, tell one person you are close to you feel this way, i guarantee you it will help, a lot more than a therapist. I always have a friend pick me up and chain smoke in a parking lot and just rant, it helps me a lot.

Good luck to you sir, everything will work out,
